---
Title: "Mallard Speed by Month"
Author: "Andrew Lucas"
format: html
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)

mallards <- readRDS("data/mallards.rds") |>
  filter(!is.na(speed), speed > 0) |>
  mutate(month = factor(month, levels = month.name, ordered = TRUE))

ggplot(mallards, aes(x = speed, y = month, fill = season)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 1.5, alpha = 0.85) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "C") +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard speed distributions by month",
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Month",
    fill = "Season"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
